name: Schea Fissel Brannick
abstract_title: Complexity Matching Between Physiological Dynamics and Artificial Attractors Reveals the Emergence of Mesoscopic Attentional States
abstract: The time course of spontaneous eye blinking, a physiological index of attention, oscillates between periods of blink inhibition, reflecting active attentional engagement, and blink facilitation, which marks the end of an attentional episode and initiates a reset of the attentional system. Inter-blink intervals (IBIs), the durations between consecutive blinks, may capture how we dynamically model, predict, and update internal representations of the world in relation to the self.
